## Personality

Timothy Cotton is regarded by others as shiftless. As a result of this reputation, his family is anticipated to become a burden on the public.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)_

## History

Before his eventual passing, Timothy Cotton spent twenty years practicing the act of dying. During his life, he once stole a crock of butter from Mrs. Lynde's dairy and falsely told his wife that he had purchased it from her.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010), [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v3 ch.Life P1](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0001), [v3 ch.Life P2](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0002), [v3 ch.Life P3](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0003), [v3 ch.Life P5](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0005), +40 more_
